name: GS75 photo fixture
description: v1 acceptance map extracted from docs/assets/keyboard.png. Blue-violet base, red navigation and a few named keys. Numpad digits stay on the base color. Validated on hardware 2026-09-12.

notes.base_color: Originally specced #00b4ff (hue 198, cyan). Hardware validation showed the real profile was blue-violet; photometric analysis of isolated regions of the reference photo gives hue 228-235. Corrected to #4a5cff. The photo carries a camera blue-cast, so treat this as an estimate - the original onboard profile is unrecoverable.
notes.nav_group: On the GS75 the nav group is 4 keys, not 6. X11 keycodes 110 (Home) and 115 (End) are absent from the upstream GE63-family keymap because they are Fn-layer functions with no dedicated LED.
